title: Compliance Evidence Variance Tracer and Retention Policy Mapper
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Build a repeatable system to map compliance controls (SOC 2 / ISO 27001) to concrete artifacts, trace variance across evidence collectors, and automate retention enforcement for region-bound data. The "Evidence Variance Tracer" will provide a canonical evidence index that: (1) associates controls to one or more artifact types and collection adapters, (2) surfaces gaps and duplicates across collectors, (3) attaches immutable provenance metadata (checksums, timestamps, collector-id, region), and (4) emits retention instructions that integrate with storage lifecycles and legal hold mechanisms. Goals: automate >80% of auditor requests for control mapping, reduce manual packaging time for quarterly audits by 70%, and provide deterministic export bundles per jurisdiction.

Scope: adapter registry for common sources (control-plane audit logs, application telemetry, S3 snapshot exports, DB backups, VPC flow logs), canonical evidence manifest schema (flat, audit-friendly), variance detection engine (de-dup + missing artifact alerts), retention policy mapper (per-customer and per-region TTL + holds), and Console UI for auditors to browse bundles and run pre-audit checks.

Out of scope: building new collectors for every data source — we will prioritize adapters for the top 6 sources by usage and provide a clear adapter SDK for third parties.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical evidence manifest defined and documented in Confluence
Adapters implemented for: control-plane audit logs, S3 object snapshots, and VPC flow logs
Variance tracer available as a nightly job that identifies missing artifacts vs control requirements with < 5% false positives
Retention mapper emits storage lifecycle instructions and supports legal hold overrides
Console view: search/filter by control, region, timeframe, and export bundles in audit-ready ZIP with signed manifest
Security review completed and threat model updated
tasks: Design canonical evidence manifest (schema + example manifests)
Prototype adapter SDK and implement 3 initial adapters
Implement provenance recording (SHA256, collector-id, region tag)
Build nightly variance-tracer pipeline and alerting
Retention policy engine: TTL rules + legal hold API
Console UX: evidence explorer + export flow
End-to-end QA with sample tenant and mock auditor requests

notes: Design decisions: Use immutable manifests stored alongside artifacts with signed metadata to prove non-repudiation. Prefer a flat manifest format (newline-delimited JSON objects) for easier streaming and auditor tooling compatibility.
Trade-offs: Tight coupling with storage lifecycle increases enforcement accuracy but requires per-provider adapters. We'll mitigate by making the retention mapper pluggable.
Rollout plan: feature-flagged beta for Dedicated customers in us-east-1, then expand to hosted tenants and EU region after legal review.
